reviews.title: Horrible
reviews.text: any travel journey begins from the flight, some bag packers choose the cheapest option which is fine as your expectations are set accordingly however I was travelling with a 1 year old child. We chose Jet airways over Sri Lankan airlines as Jet airways slightly expensive and we thought the service would be better, to our disappointment the flight was nothing less than a cramped bus. I had to squeeze in and our legs were numb by the time we arrived. I needed hot water to make my child's milk and I kept asking the attendant who paid no attention, this pissed me off and I raised my voice and asked her to bring it right away. It is ridiculous how arrogant these people can be even towards a little child. My experience was not very good..
reviews.author: Madyna

reviews.title: Excellent experience

reviews.title: A BUNCH OF LIARS
reviews.text: After having been promised a full refund-- from the Mississauga office rep-- then it was all excuses-- like your refund will be processed after this date. It was on going. Why not tell the passengers-- we are broke-- so no refund-- you money is gone. This was a reputable airline but now I think it's the worst I've dealt with & they are a bunch of liars.

reviews.author: Sondra

reviews.title: Extra charge to sit apart on wedding anniversary
reviews.text: On our Golden Wedding anniversary we were returning for the first time to my wife's place of birth. We never fly First Class, but I accepted the very expensive upgrade offer at check-in as it was a unique and emotional time for my wife. I was horrified to find we had been charged several times the economy fare to sit apart. So much for the romance! Jet Airways refused to consider any refund whatsoever - and we felt cheated.
reviews.author: Laemmergeier172

reviews.title: Refund refusal for flight cancelled at short notice
reviews.text: Our return flight was cancelled about an hour before due departure. We have received part refund - less than 50% - and the airline refuse to refund the rest. Frankly disgusted.
reviews.author: Laemmergeier172

reviews.title: Flat bed business class
reviews.text: I travelled from Mumbai to Toronto via Amsterdam by flight numbers 232/234 on 27th March 2019. The service is excellent in business class. You get flat bed to rest with good entertainment options. Food served is excellent and the courtesy and services offered by staff to make your travel comfortable is excellent.

reviews.title: Jet airways were a good domestic airline and equally bad internationally
reviews.text: Domestic Experience: Great food, comfortable seats - in line with expectations especially with the competitive price International experience: Insect in food, had to throw it away. No USB charger in seats and smelly cabins. Terrible experience. The good thing about Jet was the JP Miles which can be used to buy a lot of interesting things on their reward store.

reviews.title: Bad
reviews.text: Departure flight was half empty and had the whole bench to myself. Staff is very nice. There was not a single seat left on my returning flight, leaving me stuck in a tiny middle seat. We got plenty of food but it was not very good. They offered free wine with the meal.
reviews.author: Marisa G

reviews.title: Good airline gone...
reviews.text: This was the only flight I've ever made with the Jet Airways. Although the said airline likely went into an irreversible oblivion due to its financial mismanagement, still, its in-flight service out of Toronto to Delhi, via Amsterdam, wasn't too bad. The flight attendants were courteous and most friendly, the evening meal rather simply presented but tasty, served beverages and wines agreeable too. The plane was very clean and the leg-room better when compared to Air Canada's squeezed seating, and so was the overall attention to ordinary Economy Class passangers.
reviews.author: ppcanada2015

reviews.title: Jet Airways cancelled flight
reviews.text: So disappointed that our flight home with Jet Airways was cancelled after a great holiday in India. Had a nightmare trying to get flight home. Had booked all flights through KLM who did try and get us in a Swiss Air flight but they refused us boarding as the flight was full. Got flight with Air India and then with KLM (Via Frankfurt and Amsterdam)at 3 times the cost and had to book extra night in Delhi and Frankfurt. Tried to get a refund but claim form in website doesn’t work. Did manage to speak to someone at Jet Airways but they would have nothing to do with us as we only had KLM booking reference and e-ticket numbers. KLM can’t give us Jet Airways numbers so at a loss as what to do. Credit card company trying to get us a refund but can’t see any way of getting compensation to cover the £1800 we have had to pay out as not covered by EU law. Insurance won’t pay as company not bankrupt yet. Anyone know what to do?
reviews.author: Phunter62

reviews.title: NEVER FLY JET EVEN IF THEY SURVIVE
reviews.text: JET cancelled 5 return flights for my family with no compensation and have not declared bancruptcy or liquidation thus preventing an insurance claim. We had to pay over £4,000 pounds for new flights or cancel my 60th birthday trip of a lifetime holiday. This airline, with hindsight, has a history of cancelling flights and leaving passengers stranded as no other airlines will accept patching as they don't pay. Phone lines not anwered or any communication. We chose Jet because of flight times not cost. BA was the same price.
reviews.author: Rachel C-G

reviews.title: we miss u jet airways
reviews.text: last time i travel on 3 rd april and on 17 april the airline shut it temporarily down. but to be honest we miss u jet airways and we miss our cheap fares which u provide for us.
reviews.author: Jaspreet Singh

reviews.title: Redemption of your Jpmiles
reviews.text: April 30th, 2019 it is 3 days that I'm trying to use my JPMiles but I just can't. because when you login into your account, the system tells you that your email has been verified, but your phone number is not verified. I've tried already 10 times in 3 days to receive the text message with the activation code, but they just don't send it to me. The system says that you will receive the message with the activation code, but this message never arrives. As long as I can't verify my mobile number I can't redeem my miles, so I can't make any reservation. so they are just locking me to do that. I've talked 4 times with the customer phone number and I've already written 3 emails. this is ridiculous. this is a shame of service and I have a feeling that they are doing that on purpose. Antonio Piretti
reviews.author: ttony71
